description:
Public Service-Provider Interface (SPI) for WebMarket addon plugins.
        This artifact contains the addon entry SPI under
        cn.kurt6.webmarket.api.addon and host capability bridges under
        cn.kurt6.webmarket.api.addon.* subpackages such as inventory,
        user, platform, economy, and pending. Addons depend on this jar
        at compile time; the WebMarket host plugin provides the classes
        at runtime.
